scope: synthetic mechanism diagnostic; no market data or policy training
decision_order: Settle only outcomes available by t; issue predictions at t; outcomes cannot be settled until availability timestamp. Scoring y_t is isolated from method state.
conditioning: two observable contexts crossed with an externally supplied action label; no policy selection and no hidden regime label
primary_metric: mean squared prediction error; report all conditions and seed dispersion
limitations: Synthetic evidence cannot establish trading gains or novelty.
Equivalent contextual expert weighting remains an essential stronger baseline.
No confidence guarantee from correlated delayed errors.
Feedback for unchosen actions is not assumed available in RL integration.
